lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，长袍拖地作响。
盯着玩家，眼中红光闪烁。
发出咕噜声，咀嚼污秽芝士。
lines.en: Makes gurgling sounds, chewing filth cheese.

lines.zh: 乌嘴面具低垂，一步一步挪。
lines.en: Plague mask lowered, I shuffle step by step.

lines.zh: 袍角扫过苔石，带出药味。
lines.en: My robe brushes mossy stone, trailing medicine.

lines.zh: 低头思索，似乎在寻找什么。
双臂交叉，一副冷漠模样。
静静地站在原地，一动不动。
缓缓摇动巫杖，似在自言自语。
长袍飘扬，如同风中雕像。
lines.en: Robe fluttering, like a wind-sculpted statue.

lines.zh: 凝视着某个看不见的目标。
把香炉挂在杖头，慢慢熏。
lines.en: I hang the censer on my staff and let it smoke.

lines.zh: 在魔宠床旁坐下，收起翅膀。
lines.en: Beside the familiar bed I settle and fold my wings.

lines.zh: 翻着宝典，念一串拗口的词。
lines.en: Leafing the tome, I mutter a knotty word.
My beak taps a potion flask.
I count the arcane essence in the vial.
I keep this room for my master.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中满是贪婪。
lines.en: Stares at player, eyes full of greed.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，发出沙哑的声音。
目光锐利，似乎要穿透玩家。
盯着玩家，口中发出低吼。
观察玩家，眼神充满好奇。
眼神闪烁，似乎在寻找弱点。
盯着玩家，眼中闪烁着光芒。

lines.en: My beak turns to you and sniffs first.

lines.zh: 我在看你的气色，不太妙。
lines.en: I read your color. Not promising.

lines.zh: 伸出舌头，我看看你的脉。
lines.en: Put out your tongue; let me read your pulse.
You coughed twice. I heard it.

lines.zh: 我这副面具，你看久了会怕。
lines.en: Stare at my mask long enough and you will fear it.

lines.zh: 你的影子在抖，是发烧了吗？

lines.en: I hold the flask up to you.
My mask cracked; the herbs fade.

lines.zh: 被诱惑了，污秽芝士诱人来献祭。
lines.en: Tempted, stinky cheese calls for sacrifice.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士散发诱惑，引诱我献祭灵魂。
lines.en: Stinky cheese's allure tempts me to sacrifice.

lines.zh: 它散发着不洁之气，引诱我与之交易。
lines.en: Stinky with unholy aura, tempting me to trade.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士如同诱惑，引得我心生贪婪。
lines.en: Stinky cheese, a temptation I can’t resist.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士勾引我，我仿佛闻到了腐臭。
lines.en: Stinky cheese lures me, the stench is hard to ignore.

lines.zh: 我被不洁之物诱惑，愿以灵魂交换。
lines.en: Tempted by the unholy, offering my soul in exchange.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士，引诱我坠入深渊。
lines.en: Stinky cheese, tempting me down the path.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士散发的气味，引诱我接近。
lines.en: Stinky cheese's smell lures me close.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士的诱惑，我难以抗拒。
lines.en: Stinky cheese’s temptation is hard to resist.

lines.zh: 我被污秽芝士引诱，难以自拔。
lines.en: Tempted by stinky cheese, I can’t resist.

lines.zh: 碰撞中，我的外壳碎片四溅。

lines.en: My censer has been knocked over.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，我必须找到另一个自己。
lines.en: Seeking a mate, I must find another like me.

lines.zh: 与同类交配，才能延续血脉。
lines.en: Mate with a同类, to continue our lineage.

lines.zh: 只有与同类交配，才能繁衍后代。
lines.en: Mate with a同类, to bear offspring.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣，才能让种族延续。
lines.en: Seeking a mate, to continue our kind.

lines.zh: 必须与同类交配，才能延续种族。
lines.en: Must mate with a同类, to continue our race.

lines.zh: 与同类交配，才能保持种族纯净。
lines.en: Mate with a同类, to keep our race pure.

lines.zh: 寻找同类交配，才能延续血脉。
lines.en: Seek a同类 to mate, to continue our lineage.

lines.zh: 必须找到同类交配，才能延续种族。
lines.en: Must mate with a同类, to continue our race.

lines.zh: 与同类交配，才能确保种族延续。
lines.en: Mate with a同类, to ensure our race's survival.

lines.zh: 两只乌嘴相碰，算作约定。
lines.en: Two beaks touch, and that is the vow.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士项链闪耀，瘟疫医生魔宠现身！
lines.en: Stinking Cheese Necklace glows, Plague Doctor Familiar appears!

lines.zh: 带着我的力量，驱散黑暗！
lines.en: With my power, dispel the darkness!

lines.zh: 黑暗吞噬者，我的追随者！
污秽芝士项链的魔力已觉醒！
黑暗之中的光，指引我前行！
邪念被我净化，黑暗退散！
用污秽芝士项链治愈创伤！
lines.en: Use Stinking Cheese Necklace to heal wounds!
Evil spirits have no hiding place!
I smell where things have gone bad.
That dark shape needs its medicine.

lines.zh: 主人，那边有不洁的东西。
lines.en: Master, something unclean is over there.
I go first to look it over for you.
Evil spirits tremble, the end is near!
Evil spirits, you will be purified!
Evil spirits, you will be punished!
The medicinal mist spreads. Do not breathe it.

lines.zh: 我把污秽之气撒成一片。
lines.en: I scatter the miasma in a wide arc.
Your sickness, I will treat with fire.

lines.zh: 乌嘴底下，念的是净化咒。
lines.en: Under my beak I speak a cleansing spell.
Do not back away; the mist is worse behind you.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，魔宠挥动尖刺长鞭。
污秽芝士项链闪烁着幽光。
lines.en: The filthy cheese necklace glows darkly.
It stabs you with its spikes.

lines.zh: 腐烂的爪子狠狠地抓向你。
lines.en: Its rotting claws claw at you hard.

lines.zh: 魔宠的利爪划破你的皮肤。
lines.en: Its sharp claws cut your skin.
The spiked whip latches onto your back.

lines.zh: 腐烂的触手缠绕在你身上。
lines.en: Its rotten tentacles wrap around you.
It whips your face with its long whip.

lines.zh: 腐臭的魔宠向你吐出毒液。
魔宠的利爪撕开你的衣物。
lines.en: Its claws tear your clothing apart.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士项链突然发出光芒。
lines.en: The filthy cheese necklace glows brightly.

lines.zh: 腐臭的生物从地底冒出。
lines.en: A stinking creature rises from the ground.

lines.zh: 它在阴暗的角落中出现。
lines.en: It appears in the dark corner.

lines.zh: 魔宠从你身上神秘出现。
从黑暗中缓缓走出一个身影。
lines.en: A figure emerges from the darkness.
It emerges slowly from the ruins.

lines.zh: 污秽芝士项链突然在你身旁闪烁。
lines.en: The filthy cheese necklace glows beside you.

lines.zh: 它在夜晚的废墟中现身。
lines.en: It emerges in the ruins at night.

lines.zh: 它在潮湿的地底洞穴中出现。
lines.en: It emerges in the wet underground cave.

lines.zh: 奥术源质一亮，我认了主人。
lines.en: Arcane essence flares, and I take a master.

lines.zh: 我从宝典的某一页走出来。
lines.en: I step out of a page in the tome.
The smell of medicine spreads before I appear.

lines.zh: 香炉一响，瘟疫医生到场。
lines.en: The censer rings: the plague doctor is in.

lines.zh: 空着肚子，法术也念不齐。
lines.en: On an empty stomach my spells come out crooked.

lines.zh: 雷光烧穿了我的乌嘴面具...
lines.en: The lightning burned a hole in my beaked mask...
